set.body: ADR 0028 section 1. sourceIdentity build writes source-identity-graph/v2 in place of v1: each admitted mention gains origin, stream, intervals in edition ticks with the timebase, name, context, recognizer word indices (dialogue) and class id (least member id over all members); classes carry a contested flag; every Distinct class pair is written explicitly; relation rows name classes by class id; outcomes, manifest and input hashes kept. JSON Schema under docs/data/. Courts on the writer for every field; SD1 mutants; scoped gate. The ADR 0027 producer must pass word indices through to the inputs for dialogue mentions.
set.title: [evidence-binding S3d-1] source-identity-graph/v2 export with schema
